Arsitektur Hybrid GitHub Pages + Apps Script API

🌐 Jembatan Koneksi GitHub Pages ke Google Drive, Sheets, Gmail & Calendar

Tempelkan URL Web App Google Apps Script (berakhiran /exec) agar aplikasi di GitHub Pages dapat membaca folder bertingkat Google Drive secara langsung tanpa banner Google.

✅ URL API & URL Publik GitHub Pages tersimpan permanen! Link QR Code alat sekarang mengarah ke https://pdkbyogyakarta.github.io/portal/.

📦 Kode Backend Google Apps Script (Code.gs)

Salin kode Code.gs di bawah ini ke editor Extensions > Apps Script pada Google Sheets di akun Google Drive Anda.

/**
 * ============================================================================
 * DASHBOARD & MONITORING PDKB YOGYAKARTA - BACKEND HYBRID V11.3 (Code.gs)
 * Mendukung Mode:
 *   A) HYBRID GITHUB PAGES (Frontend di GitHub Pages + Backend API di Apps Script)
 *   B) STANDALONE GOOGLE APPS SCRIPT WEB APP (Tampilan + Backend jadi satu)
 * PT PLN (Persero) UID D.I. Yogyakarta - UP3 Yogyakarta
 * ============================================================================
 * Pembaruan V11.3:
 * - Simpan permanen URL Publik GitHub Pages (CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL).
 * - Trigger harian otomatis (07:00 WIB) untuk Monitoring Sertifikat Kompetensi
 *   (3 Bulan, 1 Bulan, 2 Minggu) DAN Monitoring Pajak & KIR Mobil SL & Mobil Personil
 *   (1 Bulan / H-30 sebelum habis) via Gmail & Google Calendar.
 * - Mendukung protokol GET JSON, JSONP (?callback=...), dan POST JSON bebas stuck.
 */

const DEFAULT_CONFIG = {
  SPREADSHEET_ID: '',
  FOLDER_HOME_ID: '',
  FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID: '',
  FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID: '',
  FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID: '',
  CALENDAR_ID: 'primary',
  ADMIN_EMAIL: 'pdkb.yogyakarta@gmail.com',
  ADMIN_USERNAME: 'admin',
  ADMIN_PASSWORD: 'pdkb2026',
  CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL: ''
};

const BULAN_INDO = [
  'Januari', 'Februari', 'Maret', 'April', 'Mei', 'Juni',
  'Juli', 'Agustus', 'September', 'Oktober', 'November', 'Desember'
];

function ping() {
  return {
    status: 'success',
    version: 'V13.0-PORTAL-FAST',
    mode: 'Hybrid GitHub Pages + Google Apps Script API',
    timestamp: Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),
    message: 'Terhubung ke Backend Google Apps Script & Google Drive PDKB Yogyakarta.'
  };
}

function doGet(e) {
  if (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.action) {
    let parsedArgs = [];
    if (e.parameter.args) {
      try {
        parsedArgs = JSON.parse(e.parameter.args);
      } catch (err) {
        parsedArgs = [];
      }
    }
    const callbackName = e.parameter.callback ? String(e.parameter.callback).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_$.]/g, '') : '';
    return handleHybridApiRequest(e.parameter.action, parsedArgs, callbackName);
  }

  const htmlOutput = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('Index').evaluate();
  htmlOutput
    .setTitle('Portal PDKB Yogyakarta | PLN UP3 Yogyakarta')
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1')
    .setXFrameOptionsMode(HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL);
  return htmlOutput;
}

function doPost(e) {
  try {
    const rawBody = (e && e.postData && e.postData.contents) ? e.postData.contents : '{}';
    const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody);
    const action = payload.action || (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.action) || '';
    const args = Array.isArray(payload.args) ? payload.args : [];
    return handleHybridApiRequest(action, args, '');
  } catch (err) {
    return createJsonResponse({
      status: 'error',
      message: 'Gagal memproses permintaan POST Hybrid API: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : String(err))
    }, '');
  }
}

function createJsonResponse(dataObj, callbackName) {
  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(dataObj);
  if (callbackName) {
    return ContentService
      .createTextOutput(callbackName + '(' + jsonStr + ');')
      .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JAVASCRIPT);
  }
  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(jsonStr)
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function handleHybridApiRequest(action, args, callbackName) {
  try {
    const a = args || [];
    let result;
    switch (String(action || '').trim()) {
      case 'ping':
        result = ping();
        break;
      case 'getDashboardData':
        result = getDashboardData();
        break;
      case 'saveAdminCmsSnapshot':
        result = saveAdminCmsSnapshot(a[0]);
        break;
      case 'saveAppConfig':
        result = saveAppConfig(a[0] || {});
        break;
      case 'listDriveFolderContents':
        result = listDriveFolderContents(a[0], a[1]);
        break;
      case 'syncLaporanFromDrive':
        result = syncLaporanFromDrive(a[0]);
        break;
      case 'readFilesFromCategoryFolder':
        result = readFilesFromCategoryFolder(a[0], a[1]);
        break;
      case 'getWorkDocsByHierarchicalDate':
        result = getWorkDocsByHierarchicalDate(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
        break;
      case 'scanWorkDocRootStructure':
        result = scanWorkDocRootStructure(a[0]);
        break;
      case 'uploadEvidenFileToDrive':
        result = uploadEvidenFileToDrive(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
        break;
      case 'verifyAdminLogin':
        result = verifyAdminLogin(a[0], a[1]);
        break;
      case 'sendGmailAndCalendarNotification':
        result = sendGmailAndCalendarNotification(a[0], a[1], a[2]);
        break;
      case 'setupDatabase':
        result = setupDatabase();
        break;
      case 'createDailyTrigger':
        result = createDailyTrigger();
        break;
      default:
        result = { status: 'error', message: 'Fungsi API tidak dikenal: ' + action };
    }
    return createJsonResponse(result, callbackName);
  } catch (err) {
    return createJsonResponse({
      status: 'error',
      message: err && err.message ? err.message : String(err)
    }, callbackName);
  }
}

function extractDriveIdFromInput(rawInput) {
  const str = String(rawInput || '').trim();
  if (!str || str.indexOf('1DRV_') === 0 || str.indexOf('1FOLDER_') === 0) return '';
  const byFolders = str.match(/\/folders\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{15,})/);
  if (byFolders && byFolders[1]) return byFolders[1];
  const bySlashD = str.match(/\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{15,})/);
  if (bySlashD && bySlashD[1]) return bySlashD[1];
  const byIdParam = str.match(/[?&]id=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{15,})/);
  if (byIdParam && byIdParam[1]) return byIdParam[1];
  const byToken = str.match(/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{20,})/);
  if (byToken && byToken[1]) return byToken[1];
  return str;
}

function getDbSpreadsheet() {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const ssId = extractDriveIdFromInput(props.SPREADSHEET_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.SPREADSHEET_ID);
  if (ssId && ssId.trim() !== '') {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(ssId.trim());
  }
  return SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
}

function setupDatabase() {
  const ss = getDbSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) {
    throw new Error('Spreadsheet tidak ditemukan. Pastikan SPREADSHEET_ID sudah diisi atau buat script dari dalam Google Sheets.');
  }

  const schema = {
    'Berkas_Home': ['ID', 'Judul', 'Kategori', 'Metode', 'Tanggal', 'NomorDokumen', 'DriveFileId', 'Ukuran', 'Ringkasan'],
    'Personil': ['ID', 'Nama', 'NIP', 'Jabatan', 'Regu', 'Telepon', 'Email', 'GradeKompetensi', 'FolderDriveId'],
    'Berkas_Personil': ['ID', 'PersonilId', 'NamaBerkas', 'JenisBerkas', 'NomorDokumen', 'TanggalTerbit', 'DriveFileId', 'Catatan'],
    'Dokumen_Kerja': ['ID', 'Tanggal', 'JudulDokumen', 'JenisDokumen', 'NomorSPK', 'LokasiPekerjaan', 'ReguPelaksana', 'DriveFileId', 'Status'],
    'Peralatan_PDKB': ['ID', 'KodeAlat', 'NamaAlat', 'KategoriAlat', 'MerkTipe', 'Kondisi', 'TanggalUjiTerakhir', 'DriveFileId', 'Keterangan'],
    'History_Uji_Peralatan': ['ID', 'AlatId', 'KodeAlat', 'TanggalUji', 'KondisiHasilTes', 'NamaEviden', 'DriveFileId', 'NomorSuratUji', 'CatatanTeknis'],
    'Sertifikat': ['ID', 'PersonilId', 'NamaPersonil', 'EmailPersonil', 'NamaSertifikat', 'NomorSertifikat', 'LembagaPenerbit', 'TanggalTerbit', 'TanggalBerlaku', 'DriveFileId', 'StatusNotifTerakhir'],
    'Log_Notifikasi_Email': ['WaktuKirim', 'NamaPersonil', 'EmailTujuan', 'NamaSertifikat', 'SisaHari', 'KategoriPengingat', 'StatusGmailDanKalender', 'Pesan'],
    'Konfigurasi_CMS': ['Key', 'JsonValue', 'UpdatedAt']
  };

  Object.keys(schema).forEach(function(sheetName) {
    let sheet = ss.getSheetByName(sheetName);
    if (!sheet) {
      sheet = ss.insertSheet(sheetName);
      sheet.appendRow(schema[sheetName]);
      sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, schema[sheetName].length)
        .setFontWeight('bold')
        .setBackground('#0F384C')
        .setFontColor('#FFFFFF');
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    }
  });

  return { status: 'success', message: 'Struktur 9 Sheet berhasil disiapkan di Google Sheets.' };
}

function listDriveFolderContents(folderLinkOrId, forceRefresh) {
  const folderId = extractDriveIdFromInput(folderLinkOrId);
  if (!folderId) {
    throw new Error('Link atau ID Folder Google Drive belum diisi.');
  }
  const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  const cacheKey = 'DRV_FOLDER_' + folderId;
  if (!forceRefresh) {
    const cached = cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      try { return JSON.parse(cached); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const folder = DriveApp.getFolderById(folderId);
  const subfolders = [];
  const filesList = [];

  const folderIter = folder.getFolders();
  while (folderIter.hasNext()) {
    const sub = folderIter.next();
    subfolders.push({
      id: sub.getId(),
      name: sub.getName(),
      updatedAt: Utilities.formatDate(sub.getLastUpdated(), 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    });
  }
  subfolders.sort(function(a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });

  const fileIter = folder.getFiles();
  while (fileIter.hasNext()) {
    const file = fileIter.next();
    const mime = file.getMimeType() || '';
    const sizeBytes = file.getSize() || 0;
    const sizeFormatted = sizeBytes > 1048576
      ? (sizeBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB'
      : sizeBytes > 0
      ? Math.max(1, Math.round(sizeBytes / 1024)) + ' KB'
      : 'Dokumen Google';
    const createdDate = Utilities.formatDate(file.getLastUpdated(), 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd');

    filesList.push({
      id: file.getId(),
      driveFileId: file.getId(),
      name: file.getName(),
      judul: file.getName(),
      mimeType: mime,
      size: sizeFormatted,
      ukuran: sizeFormatted,
      tanggal: createdDate,
      folderName: folder.getName(),
      viewUrl: 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' + file.getId() + '/view',
      previewUrl: 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' + file.getId() + '/preview',
      downloadUrl: 'https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=' + file.getId()
    });
  }
  filesList.sort(function(a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name); });

  const resultObj = {
    status: 'success',
    folderId: folder.getId(),
    folderName: folder.getName(),
    subfolders: subfolders,
    files: filesList,
    message: 'Berhasil memuat ' + subfolders.length + ' folder dan ' + filesList.length + ' file dari "' + folder.getName() + '".'
  };
  try { cache.put(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(resultObj), 300); } catch (e) {}
  return resultObj;
}

function syncLaporanFromDrive(customFolderId) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const rawFolderId = customFolderId || props.FOLDER_HOME_ID || props.FOLDER_LAPORAN_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_HOME_ID;
  return listDriveFolderContents(rawFolderId);
}

function readFilesFromCategoryFolder(folderLinkOrId, kategoriTitle) {
  return listDriveFolderContents(folderLinkOrId);
}

function getWorkDocsByHierarchicalDate(dateStr, customRootFolderId, forceRefresh) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const rawRoot = customRootFolderId || props.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID;
  const rootId = extractDriveIdFromInput(rawRoot);
  if (!rootId) {
    throw new Error('ID Folder Induk Dokumen Kerja belum diisi di Menu Admin.');
  }
  const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  const wdCacheKey = 'WD_' + rootId.slice(-10) + '_' + String(dateStr || '');
  if (!forceRefresh) {
    const cachedWd = cache.get(wdCacheKey);
    if (cachedWd) {
      try { return JSON.parse(cachedWd); } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  const parts = String(dateStr || '').split('-');
  if (parts.length !== 3) {
    throw new Error('Format tanggal tidak valid: ' + dateStr);
  }
  const yyyy = parts[0];
  const yy = yyyy.slice(-2);
  const mmNum = parseInt(parts[1], 10);
  const mmPad = ('0' + mmNum).slice(-2);
  const ddPad = ('0' + parseInt(parts[2], 10)).slice(-2);
  const bulanNama = BULAN_INDO[mmNum - 1] || '';

  const expectedMonthFolder = mmPad + '. ' + bulanNama;
  const expectedDateFolder = ddPad + '.' + mmPad + '.' + yy;
  const expectedDateAlt1 = ddPad + '.' + mmPad + '.' + yyyy;
  const expectedDateAlt2 = ddPad + '-' + mmPad + '-' + yy;

  const rootFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(rootId);

  let yearFolder = null;
  const yearIter = rootFolder.getFolders();
  while (yearIter.hasNext()) {
    const f = yearIter.next();
    const fname = f.getName().trim();
    if (fname === yyyy || fname.indexOf(yyyy) !== -1) {
      yearFolder = f;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!yearFolder) {
    return {
      status: 'not_found',
      pathResolved: rootFolder.getName() + ' / [Folder Tahun ' + yyyy + ' tidak ditemukan]',
      expectedPath: yyyy + ' / ' + expectedMonthFolder + ' / ' + expectedDateFolder,
      files: []
    };
  }

  let monthFolder = null;
  const monthIter = yearFolder.getFolders();
  while (monthIter.hasNext()) {
    const f = monthIter.next();
    const fname = f.getName().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (
      fname === expectedMonthFolder.toLowerCase() ||
      fname.indexOf(mmPad + '.') === 0 ||
      fname.indexOf(mmPad + ' ') === 0 ||
      (bulanNama && fname.indexOf(bulanNama.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
    ) {
      monthFolder = f;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!monthFolder) {
    return {
      status: 'not_found',
      pathResolved: yearFolder.getName() + ' / [Folder Bulan "' + expectedMonthFolder + '" tidak ditemukan]',
      expectedPath: yyyy + ' / ' + expectedMonthFolder + ' / ' + expectedDateFolder,
      files: []
    };
  }

  let dateFolder = null;
  const dateIter = monthFolder.getFolders();
  while (dateIter.hasNext()) {
    const f = dateIter.next();
    const fname = f.getName().trim().toLowerCase();
    if (
      fname === expectedDateFolder.toLowerCase() ||
      fname === expectedDateAlt1.toLowerCase() ||
      fname === expectedDateAlt2.toLowerCase() ||
      fname.indexOf(ddPad + '.' + mmPad) === 0 ||
      fname.indexOf(ddPad + '-' + mmPad) === 0
    ) {
      dateFolder = f;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!dateFolder) {
    return {
      status: 'not_found',
      pathResolved: yearFolder.getName() + ' / ' + monthFolder.getName() + ' / [Folder Tanggal "' + expectedDateFolder + '" tidak ditemukan]',
      expectedPath: yyyy + ' / ' + expectedMonthFolder + ' / ' + expectedDateFolder,
      files: []
    };
  }

  const filesIter = dateFolder.getFiles();
  const filesList = [];
  while (filesIter.hasNext()) {
    const file = filesIter.next();
    const sizeBytes = file.getSize() || 0;
    const sizeStr = sizeBytes > 1048576
      ? (sizeBytes / 1048576).toFixed(1) + ' MB'
      : sizeBytes > 0
      ? Math.max(1, Math.round(sizeBytes / 1024)) + ' KB'
      : 'Dokumen Google';
    filesList.push({
      id: 'DK-DRV-' + file.getId().slice(-8),
      tanggal: dateStr,
      judulDokumen: file.getName(),
      jenisDokumen: file.getMimeType() || 'Berkas Dokumen Kerja',
      nomorSpk: yearFolder.getName() + ' / ' + monthFolder.getName() + ' / ' + dateFolder.getName(),
      lokasiPekerjaan: 'Ukuran: ' + sizeStr,
      reguPelaksana: 'Tim PDKB Sentuh Langsung',
      driveFileId: file.getId(),
      status: 'Folder ' + dateFolder.getName()
    });
  }

  filesList.sort(function(a, b) { return a.judulDokumen.localeCompare(b.judulDokumen); });
  const wdRes = {
    status: 'success',
    pathResolved: rootFolder.getName() + ' / ' + yearFolder.getName() + ' / ' + monthFolder.getName() + ' / ' + dateFolder.getName(),
    expectedPath: yyyy + ' / ' + expectedMonthFolder + ' / ' + expectedDateFolder,
    folderId: dateFolder.getId(),
    files: filesList
  };
  try { cache.put(wdCacheKey, JSON.stringify(wdRes), 300); } catch (e) {}
  return wdRes;
}

function scanWorkDocRootStructure(customRootFolderId) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const rawRoot = customRootFolderId || props.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID;
  const rootId = extractDriveIdFromInput(rawRoot);
  if (!rootId) {
    throw new Error('ID Folder Induk Dokumen Kerja belum diisi.');
  }
  const rootFolder = DriveApp.getFolderById(rootId);
  const years = [];
  const yIter = rootFolder.getFolders();
  while (yIter.hasNext()) {
    const yf = yIter.next();
    years.push(yf.getName());
  }
  years.sort();
  return {
    status: 'success',
    rootFolderName: rootFolder.getName(),
    yearsFound: years,
    message: 'Terhubung ke Folder Induk "' + rootFolder.getName() + '" (Subfolder Tahun: ' + (years.join(', ') || 'Belum ada') + ').'
  };
}

function uploadEvidenFileToDrive(fileName, mimeType, base64Data) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const folderId = extractDriveIdFromInput(props.FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID);
  const decoded = Utilities.base64Decode(base64Data);
  const blob = Utilities.newBlob(decoded, mimeType || 'application/pdf', fileName || ('Eviden_Uji_Peralatan_' + Date.now() + '.pdf'));

  let file;
  if (folderId) {
    const folder = DriveApp.getFolderById(folderId);
    file = folder.createFile(blob);
  } else {
    file = DriveApp.createFile(blob);
  }

  try {
    file.setSharing(DriveApp.Access.ANYONE_WITH_LINK, DriveApp.Permission.VIEW);
  } catch (e) {}

  return {
    status: 'success',
    driveFileId: file.getId(),
    fileName: file.getName(),
    viewUrl: 'https://drive.google.com/file/d/' + file.getId() + '/view'
  };
}

function saveAdminCmsSnapshot(cmsStateJson) {
  const ss = getDbSpreadsheet();
  if (!ss) return { status: 'no_spreadsheet' };

  let cmsSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Konfigurasi_CMS');
  if (!cmsSheet) {
    setupDatabase();
    cmsSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Konfigurasi_CMS');
  }
  cmsSheet.clearContents();
  cmsSheet.appendRow(['Key', 'JsonValue', 'UpdatedAt']);
  cmsSheet.appendRow([
    'FULL_CMS_STATE',
    cmsStateJson,
    Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
  ]);
  return { status: 'success', message: 'Seluruh perubahan Admin berhasil disimpan permanen ke Google Sheets.' };
}

function getDashboardData() {
  const ss = getDbSpreadsheet();
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  if (!ss) {
    return { status: 'no_spreadsheet', config: props };
  }

  const cmsSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Konfigurasi_CMS');
  let savedCmsJson = null;
  if (cmsSheet && cmsSheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
    const vals = cmsSheet.getRange(2, 1, cmsSheet.getLastRow() - 1, 2).getValues();
    vals.forEach(function(r) {
      if (r[0] === 'FULL_CMS_STATE' && r[1]) {
        savedCmsJson = String(r[1]);
      }
    });
  }

  return {
    status: 'success',
    savedCmsJson: savedCmsJson,
    config: {
      SPREADSHEET_ID: props.SPREADSHEET_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.SPREADSHEET_ID,
      FOLDER_LAPORAN_ID: props.FOLDER_HOME_ID || props.FOLDER_LAPORAN_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_HOME_ID,
      FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID: props.FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID,
      FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID: props.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID,
      FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID: props.FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID,
      CALENDAR_ID: props.CALENDAR_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.CALENDAR_ID,
      ADMIN_EMAIL: props.ADMIN_EMAIL || DEFAULT_CONFIG.ADMIN_EMAIL,
      ADMIN_USERNAME: props.ADMIN_USERNAME || DEFAULT_CONFIG.ADMIN_USERNAME,
      CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL: props.CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL || DEFAULT_CONFIG.CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL
    }
  };
}

function saveAppConfig(newConfig) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if (newConfig.SPREADSHEET_ID !== undefined) props.setProperty('SPREADSHEET_ID', String(newConfig.SPREADSHEET_ID).trim());
  if (newConfig.FOLDER_LAPORAN_ID !== undefined) props.setProperty('FOLDER_HOME_ID', String(newConfig.FOLDER_LAPORAN_ID).trim());
  if (newConfig.FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID !== undefined) props.setProperty('FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID', String(newConfig.FOLDER_PERSONIL_ID).trim());
  if (newConfig.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID !== undefined) props.setProperty('FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID', String(newConfig.FOLDER_DOKUMEN_KERJA_ID).trim());
  if (newConfig.FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID !== undefined) props.setProperty('FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID', String(newConfig.FOLDER_PERALATAN_ID).trim());
  if (newConfig.WA_GATEWAY_URL !== undefined) props.setProperty('CALENDAR_ID', String(newConfig.WA_GATEWAY_URL).trim());
  if (newConfig.WA_ADMIN_GROUP !== undefined) props.setProperty('ADMIN_EMAIL', String(newConfig.WA_ADMIN_GROUP).trim());
  if (newConfig.CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL !== undefined) props.setProperty('CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL', String(newConfig.CUSTOM_WEBAPP_URL).trim());
  if (newConfig.ADMIN_USERNAME && String(newConfig.ADMIN_USERNAME).trim() !== '') {
    props.setProperty('ADMIN_USERNAME', String(newConfig.ADMIN_USERNAME).trim());
  }
  if (newConfig.ADMIN_PASSWORD && String(newConfig.ADMIN_PASSWORD).trim() !== '') {
    props.setProperty('ADMIN_PASSWORD', String(newConfig.ADMIN_PASSWORD).trim());
  }
  return { status: 'success', message: 'Konfigurasi Google Drive, URL GitHub Pages, Email Admin, & Kredensial Login berhasil disimpan.' };
}

function verifyAdminLogin(inputUser, inputPass) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const validUser = (props.ADMIN_USERNAME || DEFAULT_CONFIG.ADMIN_USERNAME).toLowerCase().trim();
  const validEmail = (props.ADMIN_EMAIL || DEFAULT_CONFIG.ADMIN_EMAIL).toLowerCase().trim();
  const validPass = String(props.ADMIN_PASSWORD || DEFAULT_CONFIG.ADMIN_PASSWORD).trim();

  const u = String(inputUser || '').toLowerCase().trim();
  const p = String(inputPass || '').trim();

  if ((u === validUser || u === validEmail) && p === validPass) {
    return { status: 'success', isAdmin: true, message: 'Login Admin berhasil diverifikasi.' };
  }
  return { status: 'error', isAdmin: false, message: 'Username atau Password Admin tidak sesuai.' };
}

function sendGmailAndCalendarNotification(recipientEmail, message, metaInfo) {
  const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const adminEmail = props.ADMIN_EMAIL || DEFAULT_CONFIG.ADMIN_EMAIL;
  const calendarId = props.CALENDAR_ID || DEFAULT_CONFIG.CALENDAR_ID;

  const targetEmail = (recipientEmail && recipientEmail.indexOf('@') !== -1)
    ? recipientEmail.trim()
    : adminEmail;

  const namaPersonil = metaInfo ? metaInfo.namaPersonil : 'PDKB Yogyakarta';
  const namaSertifikat = metaInfo ? metaInfo.namaSertifikat : 'Pengingat Masa Berlaku PDKB';
  const kategoriPengingat = metaInfo ? metaInfo.kategoriPengingat : 'PENGINGAT MASA BERLAKU';
  const tanggalBerlaku = metaInfo && metaInfo.tanggalBerlaku ? metaInfo.tanggalBerlaku : null;
  const jenisMonitoring = metaInfo && metaInfo.jenisMonitoring ? metaInfo.jenisMonitoring : 'SERTIFIKAT';

  let deliveryStatus = [];
  try {
    const subjectPrefix = jenisMonitoring === 'KENDARAAN'
      ? '[PDKB YOGYAKARTA - PAJAK/KIR ' + kategoriPengingat + '] '
      : '[PDKB YOGYAKARTA - ' + kategoriPengingat + '] Masa Berlaku Sertifikat: ';
    const subject = subjectPrefix + namaPersonil + (jenisMonitoring === 'KENDARAAN' ? ' (' + namaSertifikat + ')' : '');
    MailApp.sendEmail({
      to: targetEmail,
      cc: adminEmail && adminEmail !== targetEmail ? adminEmail : '',
      subject: subject,
      body: message
    });
    deliveryStatus.push('Gmail Terkirim (' + targetEmail + ')');
  } catch (err) {
    deliveryStatus.push('Gagal Gmail: ' + err.message);
  }

  try {
    const cal = (!calendarId || calendarId === 'primary')
      ? CalendarApp.getDefaultCalendar()
      : CalendarApp.getCalendarById(calendarId) || CalendarApp.getDefaultCalendar();
    if (cal) {
      const eventDate = tanggalBerlaku ? new Date(tanggalBerlaku + 'T08:00:00') : new Date();
      const eventTitle = jenisMonitoring === 'KENDARAAN'
        ? '[ Jatuh Tempo ' + namaSertifikat + ' ] ' + namaPersonil
        : '[ Habis Sertifikat PDKB ] ' + namaPersonil + ' - ' + namaSertifikat;
      const ev = cal.createAllDayEvent(eventTitle, eventDate, {
        description: message,
        location: 'PT PLN (Persero) UID D.I. Yogyakarta - UP3 Yogyakarta'
      });
      ev.addEmailReminder(30 * 24 * 60);
      ev.addEmailReminder(14 * 24 * 60);
      ev.addPopupReminder(24 * 60);
      deliveryStatus.push('Agenda Google Calendar Dibuat');
    }
  } catch (calErr) {
    deliveryStatus.push('Info Kalender: ' + calErr.message);
  }

  return { status: 'success', deliveryStatus: deliveryStatus.join(' + ') };
}

/**
 * Trigger Harian Otomatis (07:00 WIB):
 * 1) Mengecek Sertifikat Kompetensi (3 Bulan / H-90, 1 Bulan / H-30, 2 Minggu / H-14)
 * 2) Mengecek Pajak & KIR Mobil SL dan Mobil Personil (1 Bulan / H-30 sebelum habis)
 */
function checkAndSendCertificateNotifications() {
  const dash = getDashboardData();
  if (!dash || !dash.savedCmsJson) return { status: 'empty' };
  const parsed = JSON.parse(dash.savedCmsJson);
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  // 1. Cek Sertifikat Kompetensi
  if (Array.isArray(parsed.sertifikat)) {
    parsed.sertifikat.forEach(function(c) {
      if (!c.tanggalBerlaku) return;
      const exp = new Date(c.tanggalBerlaku + 'T00:00:00');
      const diffDays = Math.ceil((exp.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86400000);
      if (diffDays === 90 || diffDays === 30 || diffDays === 14 || diffDays === 0) {
        const label = diffDays <= 14 ? '2 MINGGU (H-14)' : diffDays <= 30 ? '1 BULAN (H-30)' : '3 BULAN (H-90)';
        const msg = 'Pengingat Otomatis Masa Berlaku Sertifikat Kompetensi PDKB Yogyakarta:\n' +
          '- Personil: ' + (c.namaPersonil || '-') + '\n' +
          '- Sertifikat: ' + (c.namaSertifikat || '-') + '\n' +
          '- Jatuh Tempo: ' + c.tanggalBerlaku + ' (Sisa ' + diffDays + ' hari)\n' +
          '- Status: ' + label;
        sendGmailAndCalendarNotification(c.emailPersonil || '', msg, {
          namaPersonil: c.namaPersonil,
          namaSertifikat: c.namaSertifikat,
          kategoriPengingat: label,
          tanggalBerlaku: c.tanggalBerlaku,
          jenisMonitoring: 'SERTIFIKAT'
        });
      }
    });
  }

  // 2. Cek Pajak & KIR Mobil SL dan Mobil Personil (1 Bulan / H-30 sebelum habis)
  if (Array.isArray(parsed.kendaraanPajakKir)) {
    parsed.kendaraanPajakKir.forEach(function(k) {
      if (!k.tanggalBerlaku) return;
      const exp = new Date(k.tanggalBerlaku + 'T00:00:00');
      const diffDays = Math.ceil((exp.getTime() - today.getTime()) / 86400000);
      if (diffDays === 30 || diffDays === 14 || diffDays === 7 || diffDays === 0) {
        const label = diffDays <= 0 ? 'JATUH TEMPO / HABIS' : '1 BULAN (H-' + diffDays + ')';
        const msg = 'Pengingat Otomatis Pajak / KIR Kendaraan PDKB Yogyakarta (1 Bulan Sebelum Habis):\n' +
          '- Kendaraan: ' + (k.kendaraan || '-') + (k.nopol ? ' (' + k.nopol + ')' : '') + '\n' +
          '- Jenis Dokumen: ' + (k.jenis || '-') + '\n' +
          '- Tanggal Habis Berlaku: ' + k.tanggalBerlaku + ' (Sisa ' + diffDays + ' hari)\n' +
          '- Catatan: ' + (k.catatan || '-');
        sendGmailAndCalendarNotification(k.emailTujuan || '', msg, {
          namaPersonil: k.kendaraan + (k.nopol ? ' ' + k.nopol : ''),
          namaSertifikat: k.jenis,
          kategoriPengingat: label,
          tanggalBerlaku: k.tanggalBerlaku,
          jenisMonitoring: 'KENDARAAN'
        });
      }
    });
  }
  return { status: 'success' };
}

function createDailyTrigger() {
  const triggers = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();
  triggers.forEach(function(t) {
    if (t.getHandlerFunction() === 'checkAndSendCertificateNotifications') {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
    }
  });
  ScriptApp.newTrigger('checkAndSendCertificateNotifications')
    .timeBased()
    .everyDays(1)
    .atHour(7)
    .create();
  return { status: 'success', message: 'Trigger otomatis harian (07:00 WIB) untuk pengingat Sertifikat & Pajak/KIR Kendaraan via Gmail & Google Calendar berhasil diaktifkan.' };
}
